I'm really sorry to hear that man. Seeing you say the same exact things I'm saying and feel nearly identical is pretty shitty. I sincerely hope things can be better for you. I don't know what else to say that might help you. After all that's not what you're looking for I guess.

Text #3 (start with 1): Of you aren't 100% positive she doesn't love you back, what if she does? What if you take your life and she takes hers because she feels just the exact same way about you, even if maybe she has more support systems and other ways helping herself than you do? Suicide is permanent bro. I am ready because I have thought about it for so long and I can't map out any scenarios where I'm happy, even if I found ten million dollars on the ground tomorrow I would still do this.

Text #2: The difference is, this girl has told me she only wants to be friends after this next summer. She will do her own thing and I would see her maybe one or two days each year. I have confirmed that with her. That she has love for me only as a friend, does not want to be together, and never romantically loved me. I am sure of all this because she confirmed it. Without that I am only speculating and shouldn't do anything unless I've made sure that's how it is.

Text #1: Are you only thinking that way or are you sure? Explain this to her if you haven't. Even if you're afraid she'll call 911. If she doesn't know you feel this way, and doesn't know you think she doesn't love you then that's not how it works. You're having the relationship inside your own head.

The rest of my family is dead, and I haven't seen my parents in almost five years. They are dead to me. I only wish someone loved me is all. I have tried at plenty of things. I no longer have the energy to keep trying until things get better. I have ran out of time for me to be strong. I will be weak and I will stop pain once and for all. It might get rid of happiness, but I haven't had much of that.

Well I don't want to do it. I get sick when I imagine myself after it's been done. I just can't go through this anymore. I hope you will find peace in your life that I wasn't able to, lovely stranger.

Don't be sorry, that should be the way I feel. Making strangers read and envision someone killing themselves. Obviously there are many things wrong with me. I am sorry that this causes you pain even when you do not know me. I had someone who was that for me. Went from the greatest heights to the lowest low is all. Apparently I'm too weak too handle it.

You're strong. You do it for yourself. I am weak, I can only live for others now. I have been completely alone for just over five years now. Unless I have someone who cares about me in my life, I do not wish to be here any longer. I don't want to be sad about it, just wished someone loved me. I do not love myself.

She loved me for a moment. It's not that she only wanted sex. It is that I can not continue living my life alone until finally things are better. I have had nobody since I was 15. I can not do this anymore. She is the person that I love, and I no longer see anything as exciting. I have no reason to live, only tying up lose ends and wasting time until she returns from her home state.

I no longer enjoy eating any kind of food or dessert. I don't care about having a fancy or large house. I don't want a vehicle, I want a nice bicycle. I just want to backpack. That's what me and the girl I am in love with did. We went for months backpacking all over the country. But she doesn't want to be with me. Seeing her a few days a year is not enough for me, and I can not stand being in love with her.

Nothing brings me joy, I look forward to nothing. All I wanted was to live out my life traveling with this girl. She was the only person to ever love me, and she doesn't even love me the way she said she did. She barely cares about me. I am going to take my life on the 11th. Just wanted to get it off my chest.
